consumer: The frontend map renderer reading snapshot entities.items[] to paint each ground tile's item stack; its question is 'what items lie on each ground tile around the avatar so I can draw them?'
scope: The map region around the avatar (the per-tile ground stacks of every tile in the export window), not on-person carried items and not the reachable/crafting inventory
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities(items) — iterates points_in_radius and dumps the raw get_map().i_at(p) ground stack of each tile (type_id/name/symbol/charges) with no visibility filtering, memory lag, or display formatting, so it serializes raw per-tile world state, not a GUI-formatted view
divergence: A wrench lying on the ground tile directly north of the avatar: it is in i_at(north) and MUST be painted there, but it is not in the avatar's carried/crafting inventory — a carried/reachable-inventory authority (Excerpt 2/3) paints nothing on that tile (false-empty), and any display-filtered authority that gated on seen/LOS would also drop it; only the raw per-tile i_at stack exposes it
